source: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)
title: Injured — discharged after treatment (NDRRMA)
body: NDRRMA published a list of people injured in the Rasuwa Bhotekoshi / Trishuli floods who were treated in Kathmandu hospitals and have since been discharged. Open the official NDRRMA page to search the list. This site links to NDRRMA; we do not copy names or case details.
